topic: How an HVAC Compressor Works — And Why Different Systems Use Different Compressor Types
hook: Your air conditioner moves heat because one component changes the state of the refrigerant.
objective: Explain what a compressor actually does to the refrigerant, then show why five different mechanisms exist and where each one belongs.
cta: Once you can picture what the compressor is doing, the rest of the refrigeration cycle follows.

beats.narration: Your air conditioner can move heat out of a house because of one component that changes the entire state of the refrigerant: the compressor.
